chapter_seo_title: Desolate Era Ch. 602 – Ji Ning Masters the Stele & Unlocks the Seven Techniques
chapter_meta_description: Ji Ning fully acquires the seven techniques from the Chaosworld stele, including the legendary Indestructible Body and Eighteen Gods of Taowu, and is summoned to a secret realm as its Keeper.
og_title: A Stele Beyond the Three Realms
og_description: Ji Ning’s greatest payoff yet: the Indestructible Body surpasses the Arcane Art, and seven alien techniques mark a new era for the Keeper.
twitter_description: Ji Ning unlocks techniques from beyond the Three Realms, including one that surpasses the Eight-Nine Arcane Art—now summoned as the Keeper.

lore_anchors.definition: A clone technique that allows the user to split into eighteen independent bodies, perfectly synchronized in spirit.
A divine weapon refined from the hatred and resentment of slain enemies, similar to the Fiendgod Blood-Refining Art but far more advanced.

A six-level body-protection divine ability that surpasses the Eight-Nine Arcane Art. The first three levels match the Arcane Art's peak, while the latter three can make the body as tough as an Innate spirit-treasure.
A terrifying alien great power from the Chaos who caused the Pangu and Seamless Chaosworlds to collide.
The title Ji Ning receives after fully penetrating the stele, implying he has inherited the duty of guarding a specific domain or secret realm.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why are these seven techniques so special?
cultural_notes_faq.a: They are not from the Three Realms but originate from alien races in the Chaos, making them more profound than most native arts, with some surpassing any technique the Three Realms could produce.

cultural_notes_faq.q: What is the 'Indestructible Body' compared to the Eight-Nine Arcane Art?
cultural_notes_faq.a: The text states the first three levels of Indestructible Body are equal to mastering the entire Eight-Nine Arcane Art (nine cycles), making it a strictly superior, clearer path to the same goal.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why did the stele teleport Ji Ning?
cultural_notes_faq.a: After he penetrated the divine runes, the stele's innermost program activated, recognizing him as the new 'Keeper' and transporting him to its hidden, protected space to formally receive the inheritance and his new duties.
